summary: Verified SERVER provider end-to-end in the browser. Clearing localStorage → first-run modal auto-opens (provider=gemini, no key). Selecting provider-server + Save closes modal (no key required) and persists {provider:'server'} in localStorage. Clicking activate-recruteur-btn streams a RECRUTEUR prose response (329 chars, no bullet characters, no markdown bold) with no error toast. Reset+new session flow: activate-candidat-btn + 'Parlez-moi de vos points forts' + send-btn produces exactly 3 candidate-bullet-0/1/2 elements, each containing bolded highlight spans. After reload, the settings modal stays closed and generation continues to work in Serveur mode. Reopening Settings shows provider-server highlighted (border-indigo-500/60) and provider-gemini unselected. All 4 requested scenarios PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: SettingsPanel useEffect resets local state on every `open` toggle — fine; provider selection correctly reflects saved value on reopen.
InterviewConsole first-run gate `st.provider !== 'server' && !st.geminiKey` correctly suppresses auto-open in server mode after save+reload.

streamServer parses SSE without newline reassembly of multi-line `data:` events — currently works because backend emits single-line JSON per event; if future backend chunks data across lines this will break.
seed_data_creation: None — localStorage was cleared at test start.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SERVER provider mode is fully working via the external preview URL. Recruteur streams prose (no bullets/bold), Candidat streams exactly 3 bullets with bold highlights. Settings persists provider='server' in localStorage under key 'settings'. First-run modal correctly suppressed after saving server provider. To reproduce: always start with localStorage.clear() to avoid stale state from previous iterations.
